name: com.xengine.hudmesh
description: World-space overhead HUD mesh system ported from UnityHUD: stacked nameplates (health bar, name, title, guild name, guild icon), floating damage numbers (SDF text or digit-atlas styles), and chat bubbles. All HUD quads are combined into one dynamic mesh per material and billboarded to the camera. Official optional package: listed in Package Manager, not mounted until installed.

samples.description: Playable scene: five nameplates with bars, floating damage numbers and a chat bubble, driven entirely by the public Hud API.
